Good evening, Democrats won control of both the House and Senate in a decisive blue wave. The sweeping electoral rout will be widely viewed as a rebuke of President Donald Trump’s second-term agenda. Find the details here. The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained more than 1,500 points and stocks broadly rallied after Democrats took control of both chambers of Congress. Will Democrats vote to impeach President Donald Trump for a third time? It’s unclear if there’s an appetite. Democrats’ impending majority in Congress could mean investigations for AI companies, defense contractors and more. Thanks for reading! Kris Kornbluth Assistant Editor, Platforms & Curation More Recommended Reads How Vivek Ramaswamy’s Bet On Donald Trump Backfired Vivek Ramaswamy tied his political future to Trump and embraced his brand of personal attacks. The billionaire’s failed Ohio campaign exposed the costs of that bargain. These Billionaires Are Winning—And Losing—Big After Democrats Sweep Midterms A Democratic Congress threatens AI companies and their leaders with aggressive regulation, moratoriums on data center development and investigations. The fortunes of billionaires are already being affected.
